candidates.name: Multi-Hat Repository Audit
candidates.summary: Runs architecture, security, testing, release, dependency, performance, and operational review as separable evidence tracks.

candidates.name: Runtime Integrity Gate
candidates.summary: Checks contract closure, state-machine closure, persistence, recovery, event ordering, replay, and evaluation readiness before runtime freeze.

candidates.name: Deterministic Replay & Verification
candidates.summary: Reconstructs runtime history and verifies deterministic or bounded-divergence replay against canonical events.

candidates.name: Legacy Donor Extraction
candidates.summary: Inspects an older project or backup and classifies reusable material as keep, port, adapt, reference, or reject without importing product identity.

candidates.name: Monorepo Reconstruction
candidates.summary: Recovers package boundaries, workspace topology, scripts, configuration, and missing integration glue, then verifies the resulting build graph.

candidates.name: Pinned Upstream Adoption Review
candidates.summary: Evaluates third-party/upstream code at a pinned revision and returns ADOPT, FORK, REFERENCE, or REJECT with license, security, build, and fit evidence.

candidates.name: One-Click Installer Packager
candidates.summary: Produces platform-aware launch/install scripts, environment bootstrap, dependency checks, validation, and reversible recovery guidance.

candidates.name: Deployment-Ready Package Builder
candidates.summary: Turns a project into a platform-specific deployment handoff with manifests, environment templates, smoke checks, and rollback instructions.

candidates.name: Runtime Adapter Normalizer
candidates.summary: Normalizes heterogeneous runtimes behind discover, configure, health, invoke, stream, cancel, and inspect contracts.

candidates.name: Agent / Tool Provisioning Pipeline
candidates.summary: Catalogs, checks compatibility, gathers approval, provisions dependencies/secrets, registers capabilities, health-checks, and activates agents/tools.

candidates.name: Memory Consolidation
candidates.summary: Reflects on execution, resolves contradictions and duplicates, applies retention/decay rules, mines skill candidates, validates, and checkpoints.

candidates.name: Typed Memory Fabric
candidates.summary: Structures working, episodic, semantic, procedural, decision, relational, and skill memory with provenance and migration support.

candidates.name: Contextual Association & Salience
candidates.summary: Retrieves and links related memories, detects contradiction/goal drift, scores salience, suppresses noise, and surfaces evidence-backed context.

candidates.name: Browser Capture & Memory Staging
candidates.summary: Captures selected browser content into provenance-backed staging capsules before durable memory classification and sync.

candidates.name: DOM / Component Reconstruction
candidates.summary: Captures browser-visible DOM/CSS/layout/resources from authorized pages and reconstructs reusable component specifications and implementations.

candidates.name: Toptier Topology
candidates.summary: Plans route, region, component, state, interaction, and responsive topology before frontend scaffolding.

candidates.name: Registry Compiler & Validator
candidates.summary: Validates canonical skill packages, resolves dependencies, hashes content, and produces deterministic registry indexes.

candidates.name: Registry Migration & Parity Auditor
candidates.summary: Compares old/new registries across IDs, routing, contracts, status, runtime bindings, and provenance, blocking cutover on drift.

candidates.name: Model Capability Router
candidates.summary: Routes tasks to suitable local or API model classes using capability, hardware, privacy, latency, context, and budget constraints.

candidates.name: Campaign Asset Production
candidates.summary: Turns approved brand/product references into platform-ready campaign mockups, crops, short-video prompts, trailer sequences, and handoff packs.

candidates.name: Release Matrix & Build Verification
candidates.summary: Verifies build/typecheck/lint/test/package/runtime matrices and records reproducible release evidence.

candidates.name: SBOM & Vulnerability Assessment
candidates.summary: Produces dependency inventory, license/security findings, vulnerability evidence, and remediation priority without equating scans with exploitability.

candidates.name: Threat Boundary Audit
candidates.summary: Maps trust boundaries, identity/authorization paths, secret exposure, untrusted execution, egress, and privilege escalation surfaces.

candidates.name: Async & Race Condition Audit
candidates.summary: Inspects concurrency, cancellation, ordering, stale writes, retries, idempotency, and multi-writer race surfaces.

candidates.name: Cache & Incremental Correctness Audit
candidates.summary: Verifies cache keys, invalidation, incremental builds, stale artifacts, persistence boundaries, and reproducibility under repeated runs.

candidates.name: Agent-Readiness Verification
candidates.summary: Checks whether an application exposes durable sessions, tool/action state, evidence, errors, cancellation, and observability required by real agents.

candidates.name: Source-Bound Reconstruction
candidates.summary: Reconstructs a project or specification only from provided evidence, classifies missing/inferable/placeholder artifacts, and preserves source boundaries.

candidates.name: Evidence-Grounded Research
candidates.summary: Performs source-backed research with freshness, authority, fact/inference separation, citations, and explicit uncertainty.
